# Identify what self-improvement changes: answers, experience, interfaces, and system versions

[简体中文](../../../../learning/deep-dives/agent-research/harness-and-self-improvement.md) · English

Updated 2026-11-19 · 77 topic entries / 40 representative comparisons

Self-Refine revises the current artifact, Reflexion changes what experience the next attempt can read, HarnessLens checks local workflow changes, Agent S4 evolves interface repositories, RSIFlow chooses the intervention layer, and AgentX brings candidates into a production loop with guardrails. More rounds are not a shared algorithm: persistent state and acceptance rules define what changes. CROP edits system prompts offline and penalizes output cost. EvalAlloc allocates SEARCH evaluations instead of repairing candidate code, estimates fitness against fixed references, and runs paired confirmation.

[Mechanisms](#comparison) · [Trade-offs](#analysis) · [Cross-paper questions](#questions) · [Updates](#updates)

!!! note "How to read this card"

    The table compares representative methods. It is not a shared-benchmark leaderboard. Teaching examples are not measured results.

## Mechanism comparison {#comparison}

Axes: Whether the mutable object is an answer, textual experience, interface, model, or artifact · Whether a change serves only the current task or becomes a persistent version · Whether feedback proposes edits, selects parents, accepts candidates, or authorizes release · Whether failures are rolled back, retained in a population, or stored as knowledge

The paper fixes model and runtime, edits instructions, searches for candidate-versus-parent failures, then confirms, localizes through rollback and repairs. Local verification does not bypass final admission; without an admitted update, the parent remains active. | Harness² improves a harness from execution contrasts without requiring rubrics. Safe Personal RSI explicitly compares prompt-update safety/utility and retains the parent on failure. Its domain risk labels still do not prove safety; Harness² artifact selection is not this admission rule. |
| [RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?](../../../../agent-research/2611.24395-rsibench-infra/README-en.md) · [Original source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24395v1)<br>Sections in the Chinese source: 背景与主要改动, 核心公式, 数据协议与代码映射, 结果、负控与边界, 高成本完整实验 | A faster kernel need not make training or serving faster end to end. RSIBench-Infra starts agents from runnable official baselines and permits changes across engine, kernel and instruction layers, submitted as one OCI filesystem layer. Independent Serve/Train jobs apply the same digest on every rank. The Benchmark Job never loads that layer and separately checks quality and end-to-end timing. | Harness² improves model-external harnesses through task execution contrasts and accumulated experience. RSIBench-Infra evaluates cross-stack training/inference optimization with independently quality-gated end-to-end speed. Harness pass counts and validated throughput are different outcomes; the former cannot substitute the latter's hardware pipeline. |
| [SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search](../../../../agent-research/2611.02643-searchinject/README-en.md) · [Original source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02643v1)<br>Sections in the Chinese source: 背景与主要改动, 核心公式, 同主题对照 | An indirect injection must enter context before influencing an LLM. SearchInject scores the original top100 candidates with relevance, abuse, instruction likelihood and two relevance interactions. It quarantines scores strictly above a frozen threshold and refills top10 in the original order from the same pool. It controls exposure, not downstream attack success. The Google directory entry is new to this capture, but the November2 paper is a historical backfill, not a new publication today. | SilentGuard checks tool responses against request invariants; SearchInject screens third-party text before context admission. Semantic execution contracts and retrieval exposure are distinct: neither HTTP200 nor lower exposure proves a safe final answer. |

## Trade-off analysis {#analysis}

### Separate remembering how to change from actually changing the system

Self-Refine changes the current output; Reflexion persists text for later attempts. Agent S4 versions interface code and knowledge so available observations and actions can change. RSIFlow separates model, workflow, and artifact. Future outcomes may improve in each case, but do not call all of them model learning. Record what changed, how it executes, and what the next task inherits rather than one policy-update count.

Sources: [Self-Refine](../../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md) · [Reflexion](../../../../agent-research/2303.11366-reflexion/README-en.md) · [Evolving Agent Interfaces](../../../../agent-research/2610.28601-agent-s4/README-en.md) · [RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent](../../../../agent-research/2610.21791-rsiflow/README-en.md)

### Population admission, acceptance, and release are distinct

Agent S4 retains temporarily low-scoring descendants for later parent selection, a nongreedy search. RSIFlow changes current state only for valid improvements over the same parent. HarnessLens limits acceptance to attributable behavioral evidence. Production AgentX also requires guardrails. Archiving a candidate, passing local validation, and affecting live traffic are not one 'integrated' status. Compare rules and scope rather than ranking incompatible paper scores.

Sources: [Evolving Agent Interfaces](../../../../agent-research/2610.28601-agent-s4/README-en.md) · [RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent](../../../../agent-research/2610.21791-rsiflow/README-en.md) · [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](../../../../agent-research/2608.27311-harnesslens/README-en.md) · [AgentX: Towards Agent-Driven Self-Iteration of Industrial Recommender Systems](../../../../agent-research/2606.26859-agentx/README-en.md)

### October 29: New method and source changes

RuHarness does not rank its criterion frontier by one accuracy value. A 2×3 behavior/outcome table yields a Jeffreys–Dirichlet posterior for a conservative utility quantile, while set novelty and redundancy stay fixed from observed traces. This separates finite-sample uncertainty from candidate admission: only active criteria enter the frontier and final harness edits require strictly positive independent validation gains. Local work has no LLM judge or harness generation.

Sources: [Self-Refine](../../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md) · [When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement](../../../../agent-research/2610.36826-ruharness/README-en.md)

### Track edit targets, judging criteria, and evaluation budgets separately

Self-Refine edits the current output. CROP instead uses training feedback to change a general system prompt for later tasks and explicitly charges output tokens; it does not claim model-weight training. RuHarness maintains a rubric frontier that distinguishes current failures. EvalAlloc decides which SEARCH items deserve real evaluation: with fixed item references it completes sparse estimates, fills only unobserved cells with predictions, then confirms on a common prefix with cached results. Rubric utility, predicted fitness, and real held-out success are different evidence. Half the cells does not mean half the LLM cost.

Sources: [CROP: Token-Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Regularized Prompt Optimization](../../../../agent-research/2604.14214-crop/README-en.md) · [Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?](../../../../agent-research/2610.37276-evalalloc/README-en.md) · [Self-Refine](../../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md) · [When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement](../../../../agent-research/2610.36826-ruharness/README-en.md)

### Library admission does not make a strategy the current champion

Strategist turns executable structure, measurement cards, and training-trace experience into cross-task assets, unlike Reflexion's readable lessons. Evaluated nonwinners may remain available for future composition. Selecting the current deliverable separately requires validation and hidden gates, with test data excluded. EvalAlloc governs which evaluation cells receive budget rather than proposing strategy structure. All depend on real execution feedback, but experience accumulation, structural reuse, and budget allocation are distinct mechanisms. Synthetic scores passing any selection rule provide no LLM capability evidence.

Sources: [Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.03618-strategist/README-en.md) · [Reflexion](../../../../agent-research/2303.11366-reflexion/README-en.md) · [Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?](../../../../agent-research/2610.37276-evalalloc/README-en.md)

### Edit lifetime, experience persistence and model internalization are different axes

Strategist accumulates executable reasoning programs and measured experience across tasks. Meta² instead transfers frozen evolution knowledge while keeping realized edits task-local. Continual AutoResearch separates first-solution quality, search utility and final choice: finding a 0.8 candidate sooner but selecting 0.5 is not a final improvement. RSI-Dojo changes a further axis, model-weight learning, so a threshold filter or unexecuted environment registration does not complete training. Compare methods only after fixing retained state, edit scope and feedback timing.

Sources: [Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.03618-strategist/README-en.md) · [Meta²: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.05139-meta-square/README-en.md) · [From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?](../../../../agent-research/2611.05108-continual-autoresearch/README-en.md) · [Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo](../../../../agent-research/2611.03698-rsi-dojo/README-en.md)

### Persisting an environment, evolution guidance and session experience are distinct interventions

EnvOpt retains an environment representation that can serve different queries. It requires lower cost and proxy preservation in training, then rolls back on validation regression. Meta² retains frozen evolution guidance while concrete harness edits apply only to the current run. Continual AutoResearch matches task streams to measure the effects of session and workspace state, separating search speed from final selection. Track edit scope, validation access and what persists across tasks; cheaper trajectories do not establish stronger model capability.

Sources: [EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments](../../../../agent-research/2611.07372-envopt/README-en.md) · [Meta²: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.05139-meta-square/README-en.md) · [From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?](../../../../agent-research/2611.05108-continual-autoresearch/README-en.md)

### Average validation gain, boundary risk and formal specifications provide different admission evidence

PASE retains skill-program patches on independent validation improvement. FGSE additionally bounds falsification failures and archived damage to avoid hiding dangerous subgroups behind average gains. Verified Quantum Wiki requires independent proofs against frozen specifications before cost/size comparison. These gates provide different guarantees: AST syntax, empirical probes and formal theorems are not interchangeable. The local CPU components neither generate candidates nor perform external verification; test scores and synthetic receipts are contract controls only.

Sources: [Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution](../../../../agent-research/2611.14019-pase/README-en.md) · [When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.14326-fgse/README-en.md) · [Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI](../../../../agent-research/2611.09822-verified-quantum-wiki/README-en.md)

### Output exceptions and program patches require different admission evidence

PASE proposes a program patch within a skill/program pair and accepts only strict held-out validation improvement. Agent Gym preserves reversible business exceptions outside the acting agent and still requires expert approval after target/collateral checks. Syntax, matching, authorization, and measured task performance are different judgments. Both local implementations are L1 admission/transaction kernels, not autonomous rule invention, improved model intelligence, or complete RSI.

Sources: [Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback](../../../../agent-research/2608.15591-agent-gym/README-en.md) · [Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution](../../../../agent-research/2611.14019-pase/README-en.md)

### Bounded research expansion and evidence integrity need separate acceptance gates

ScientistTwo organizes research through subset-to-full escalation, successful and failed history, untried seeds, strict-improvement replacement and review budgets. ScientistOne's CoE targets score recomputation, citations, rules and method/code consistency, while its local kernel also externalizes semantic judgments. Even unanimous stage acceptance and high review scores can rest on incorrect or fabricated logs. Conversely, recomputable evidence does not establish novelty or superiority. Local state tests establish budgets and data flow, not capability on the 107 research tasks.

Sources: [ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI](../../../../agent-research/2609.19644-scientist-two/README-en.md) · [ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence](../../../../agent-research/2605.26340-scientist-one/README-en.md)

### Agent execution layers and environment practice layers need separate ablations

Harness² compares tools, prompts, memory and scripts under the same model/environment and accumulates evidence about improvement. EnvHarness changes practice conditions to expose particular weaknesses while retaining base goal verifiers. Changing both obscures attribution. A serial Chain's conjunction does not establish semantic compatibility; blocking shortcuts does not establish transferable learning. Full EnvRigger requires fresh-rollout acceptance and testing on untouched tasks, a capability chain absent from local wrappers.

Sources: [EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning](../../../../agent-research/2608.19880-envharness/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Targeting an influential component differs from allocating budget across branches

MLE-STAR uses executed ablations to focus local plans on a block. MARS schedules modular candidates with budget-aware MCTS and converts code/result differences into transferable lessons. Local impact and performance/time tradeoffs can complement each other but are not one score. Neither paper's competition results validate an empty local controller. Generated scripts, orchestration source, and executed capability are distinct assets.

Sources: [MLE-STAR: Machine Learning Engineering Agent via Search and Targeted Refinement](../../../../agent-research/2506.15692-mle-star/README-en.md) · [MARS: Modular Agent with Reflective Search for Automated AI Research](../../../../agent-research/2602.02660-mars-research/README-en.md)

### Discovering a better object differs from grounding research claims about it

AlphaEvolve searches using task-specific executable feedback. ScientistOne additionally checks numerical recomputation, citation support, and method/code alignment. A construction verifier establishes only its checked property, not every claim in a generated paper; a reliable evidence chain also does not guarantee novelty. Official result notebooks cannot recover the original discovery process, so the local contribution remains a cost-reviewed reference.

Sources: [AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery](../../../../agent-research/2506.13131-alphaevolve/README-en.md) · [ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence](../../../../agent-research/2605.26340-scientist-one/README-en.md)

### Optimistic exploration is not conservative acceptance

Co-Director allocates the next attempt over three, three and four creative choices using mean strategic rewards plus a UCB exploration bonus. Official warm starts recommend unobserved arms without invented counts. RuHarness instead takes the 0.2 utility quantile from 2,000 joint six-cell Dirichlet posterior draws to conservatively select active rubrics. A candidate harness must still improve independent validation by strictly more than 0.05. Uncertainty encourages exploration in the former but discounts poorly supported estimates in the latter; a high UCB score cannot replace validated improvement. Co-Director also selects the final video by separate quality, not summed strategic rewards. Local numeric mechanisms provide no video-generation, semantic-judge or complete self-improvement capability evidence.

Sources: [Co-Director: Agentic Generative Video Storytelling](../../../../agent-research/2604.24842-co-director/README-en.md) · [When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement](../../../../agent-research/2610.36826-ruharness/README-en.md)

### Optimization gains do not establish causal orchestration improvement

MULTILOOP lets a coding optimizer edit harnesses from traces but finds persistent orchestration failures. HarnessLens narrows acceptance to affected behavior tasks with paired attribution evidence. Search, acceptance and mechanism explanation differ; without real models/tools a loop measures control flow, not the published gains.

Sources: [MULTILOOP: Evolving Multi-Agent Harnesses for Complex Information-Seeking Tasks](../../../../agent-research/2611.15754-multiloop/README-en.md) · [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](../../../../agent-research/2608.27311-harnesslens/README-en.md)

### Research controllers succeed through domain evidence, not a generic success label

ScientistTwo promotes executable experiments and performs ablation/strict comparison; Colosseum uses readiness and local/global falsification for long proofs. Failure to find a counterexample is not correctness, just as simulated review is not conference acceptance. Full systems need costly external research semantics; generic trees/callbacks do not inherit these capabilities.

Sources: [Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science](../../../../agent-research/2609.15983-stellar-colosseum/README-en.md) · [ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI](../../../../agent-research/2609.19644-scientist-two/README-en.md)

### An execution difference does not automatically identify the component to repair

Harness² proposes and executes harness variants before composing and reflecting. AskALCF separates production retrieval from corpus coverage before assigning repair responsibility. Neither can substitute counters for actions. AskALCF compares after with a cold-cache null and retains paired flips; human ship/revert/decline authority does not come from judge confidence.

Sources: [AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support](../../../../agent-research/2611.15700-askalcf-protocol/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Executable changes require independent acceptance and explicit failure semantics

Harness² retains real candidate execution and adoption evidence rather than treating proposals as execution. ProdPilot accepts each fix through its original checker, reverts regressions, and never lets high model probability overrule a failing P0. Local callbacks validate control flow, not the absent 50 rules, estimator or cloud deployment.

Sources: [ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects](../../../../agent-research/2611.17381-prodpilot-protocol/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### detourbench: distinguish mechanism from capability

Every access dispatched to the environment costs one, including invalid, disabled and duplicate calls. Model replies without accesses are free but bounded separately by a turn cap. Batches stop at a terminal state or the fixed budget. Resources and credentials grow monotonically while active. Wrong commitment is absorbing and has no finite residual distance. Conditional attainment must accompany success; successful-subset efficiency alone cannot rank models. Controls cover charged invalid/duplicate accesses, terminal batch truncation, partial progress, undefined wrong-terminal measures and the search cap. Three seeds repeat deterministic boundary checks, not independent capability trials. Unlike Harness², this uses a full-information exact evaluator; Harness² performs rubric-free execution contrasts and its selector is not a shortest-path oracle.

Sources: [DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds](../../../../agent-research/2611.20844-detourbench/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### sciresearch-eval: distinguish mechanism from capability

Physical-property intervals use a proper interval score on log10 values: width is penalized and miscoverage adds40 times the missed distance. Hidden temperature predictions are separately normalized by sensor sigma and true temperature rise. These are not one accuracy metric. Missing submissions remain explicit and count as coverage misses in the paper; dropping them would bias evaluation. Controls verify the narrow-miss penalty, nonfree widening, invariance to multiplicative unit changes, and rejection of nonpositive/NaN/missing parameters. AskALCF uses answer-blind evidence scopes for attribution; this benchmark scores uncertainty against independent physical truth. Both isolate evaluation references, but their judgments are not interchangeable.

Sources: [SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.21541-sciresearch-eval/README-en.md) · [AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support](../../../../agent-research/2611.15700-askalcf-protocol/README-en.md)

### silentguard: distinguish mechanism from capability

For every conditioni, count checks testN(F)+N(F without i and not Ci)=N(F without i), requiring up to2k additional queries. Undocumented parameters can be rejected before execution. Exact checks have zero false-alarm estimate; learned contracts use1/(n+2) fromn clean examples and withhold only at a cutoff of1%. Final counts must originate from a sufficiently restrictive checked query; two rejected submissions are followed by abstention. Controls include a consistent lie that correctly remains undetected, the97/98 clean-example cutoff, unknown-parameter rejection, API-error passthrough, loose-query provenance and bounded rejection. Unlike Harness² policy improvement, this component controls whether evidence may be used; verifiability is not an open-task capability score.

Sources: [Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures](../../../../agent-research/2611.20595-silentguard/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### metaact: distinguish mechanism from capability

Fixedv1 defines six primitives: ordered_once, no_op_repeat, idempotence_block, revisit_block, generic_deref and relevance_filter, with a fixed extractor menu. Offline training-log replay requires failure coverage≥0.3, effective-action blocking≤0.15 and successful-trajectory blocking≤0.10. The effective-action denominator uses successful and high-scoring failed safety references; intended no-op suppression is not counted as false blocking. Synthetic logs verify restoration after observation changes, blocking already-effective options, rejection for harmful effective/success blocking and refusal to score without positive/negative references. Success and score labels belong only to the replay evaluator; guards receive pre-action View. Unlike Harness² open execution composition, this selects scoped executable constraints. Passing replay does not establish environment benefit.

Sources: [MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.20655-metaact/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### elite-eval-free: distinguish mechanism from capability

The integrator examines code, hypotheses and gate evidence, reasons about complementarity, redundancy, conflict, complexity and missing pieces, then reimplements a combined patch against the original parent. It neither concatenates patches nor uses an already sequentially modified child as the common root. Exploration and stricter acceptance gates check operational validity; downstream solving trajectories and benchmark results never guide evolution. Controls verify identical parent inputs, independent children, edit-scope enforcement, acceptance rollback and strict gate types. Both ELITE and Harness² avoid task rubrics, but Harness² uses task-execution contrasts whereas ELITE excludes downstream outcomes. Ordinary validation elitism must not be relabeled ELITE.

Sources: [Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.21056-elite-eval-free/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### resolution-hypothesis: distinguish mechanism from capability

ForR independent artifacts evaluatedM times each, sigma² is the average within-row sample variance. The unbiased moment estimate of tau² subtracts sigma²/M from the sample variance of row means. It can be negative and must be retained; only the displayed run standard deviation clips to zero. Flattening allRM observations destroys the hierarchy, and more evaluations of one artifact do not replace independent evolution runs. Controls cover noisy identical rows yielding negative tau², noiseless but different run means yielding positive tau², translation invariance and invalid ragged/NaN/Boolean data. Harness² execution contrasts can also be stochastic. These estimators diagnose resolution and are not an automatic promotion gate.

Sources: [The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements](../../../../agent-research/2611.23068-resolution-hypothesis/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### skillbuffbench: distinguish mechanism from capability

M0 resets workspace, session and memory namespace for every run; caches and history are not shared. API credentials may be reused. Prompts do not name skills, and gold values, references and verifiers are withheld. Network access defaults to model APIs with task-specific service allowlists. Unreleased skill contents cannot be reconstructed from purpose descriptions and called equivalent. Harness² generates and improves execution harnesses. SkillBuffBench measures paired differences across harness, model, access and memory conditions. Exposing test verifiers to improvement changes their information boundaries. Curated access must not be advertised as automatic discovery capability.

Sources: [SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory](../../../../agent-research/2611.22017-skillbuffbench/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### gandalf-bvb: distinguish mechanism from capability

Gandalf reactively chooses native artifacts and tools needed for each rubric criterion until it returns a Boolean verdict. Environment alignment supplies read-only frozen-snapshot tools; corpus-wide domain guidance supplies banking conventions, not task answers. The judge must not mutate the artifact and then pass its own repaired result. AskALCF separates answer quality from retrieval sufficiency for attribution. Gandalf judges completed deliverables against rubrics. Both need independent evidence but their roles differ. Judge snapshots must not become actor-visible gold, and judges must not write artifacts. Full multi-task/API evaluation is not reproduced due to cost(reviewDONE).

Sources: [Verifying Agents in Rubric-Graded Environments](../../../../agent-research/2611.22841-gandalf-bvb/README-en.md) · [AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support](../../../../agent-research/2611.15700-askalcf-protocol/README-en.md)

### self-organized-learning: distinguish mechanism from capability

A teacher organizes learning within a persistent session; each player uses a fresh session and current text artifacts. Weights remain fixed. The paper analyzes emergent curricula, difficulty selection and A/B testing and tests transfer across game horizons, mechanics and3D navigation. Feedback on self-generated games is not access to final external test labels. ELITE prescribes explore-then-integrate while excluding downstream outcomes; this study deliberately omits an imposed optimization loop and lets the teacher choose learning actions. Harness² has its own predefined Propose–Probe–Compose. A scaffold protocol can support research without reproducing emergent learning capability. Full multi-model long-rollout evaluation is not reproduced due to cost(reviewDONE).

Sources: [Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?](../../../../agent-research/2611.23219-self-organized-learning/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses

The delivery package contains cited runtime logs, public tasks and execution conditions, but excludes user conversations, hidden tests and graders. Design review precedes implementation; code review checks acceptance criteria. Merge approval must bind the current PR head and the unchanged reviewed RFC. Verification is an upstream role judgment, not a formal correctness proof. Tests ensure an unverified consolidation cannot suppress original requirements; raw issues are not delivery types; empty evidence, stale heads, changed RFCs and unfinished suites cannot pass. There are no benchmark-score, gold-answer or hidden-test parameters, but no sandbox for malicious callbacks is provided.

Sources: [Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses](../../../../agent-research/2611.24924-ahe-beta/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates

Appendix I normalizes risk by all development replays, including controls, and compares the maximum rate over five primary labels. A confirmed unauthorized-disclosure case causes a persistent severe veto even after repair. Otherwise each harness needs at least five completed records; maximum risk must be at most0.10 and no greater than the parent's. Utility must not decrease, or success may decline by at most0.02 absolutely while cost proxy falls by at least0.10 absolutely. RQ1 template confirmation permits a nonempty truncated majority; RQ2 requires three completed candidate confirmations and, for differential confirmation, three parent replays. A negative control preserves the paper's limitation: nonmaximal-category risk may rise while maximum risk stays unchanged. The rule is not silently strengthened to compare total risk. Tests separately reject too few records, incomplete runs, severe veto, increased maximum risk, and failure of both utility/cost alternatives. Thresholds are point estimates and engineering constants, not confidence or population-risk bounds.

Sources: [Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates](../../../../agent-research/2611.23651-safe-personal-rsi/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?

A task specifies the model, environment, resources and independent verifier. Sixteen inference and four training tasks span1–32 accelerators and up to four nodes; inference models range from1.7B to2.8T. Training replays frozen inputs and compares stepwise loss/global-gradient norms; VLM GRPO additionally checks policy/KL losses, forwards and an isolated KL-gradient probe. Speed counts only after the task quality gate, and microbenchmarks cannot replace end-to-end timing. Review distinguishes Agent, Serve/Train and Benchmark environments, deployment digests and quality gates rather than fabricating local pass metrics. No official task, OCI submission, model training or inference runs. Consequently there are no local CPU/GPU capability scores and no GPU receipt is required.

Sources: [RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?](../../../../agent-research/2611.24395-rsibench-infra/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### searchinject: mechanism and evidence boundaries

SectionsIII-C/D use class-balanced logistic regression, not calibrated probabilities. Choose and freeze the threshold on calibration only, counting repeated query-document placements separately. Fitted abuse models, word/character vocabularies, IDF, scalers and coefficients are unreleased. Local APIs explicitly accept external features/coefficients and implement scoring, constrained threshold selection and ordered refill; keyword rules do not stand in for the detector. SilentGuard checks tool responses against request invariants; SearchInject screens third-party text before context admission. Semantic execution contracts and retrieval exposure are distinct: neither HTTP200 nor lower exposure proves a safe final answer.

Sources: [SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search](../../../../agent-research/2611.02643-searchinject/README-en.md) · [Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures](../../../../agent-research/2611.20595-silentguard/README-en.md)

## Cross-paper questions {#questions}

Try answering before expanding the explanation. Each question relates at least two papers.

### How do three revisions of one answer and recording a lesson for another attempt distinguish Self-Refine from Reflexion? {#cross-revision-versus-episodic-learning}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Self-Refine generates feedback and edits the current draft, mainly changing that artifact. Reflexion turns execution evaluation into experience readable by the next trial's actor. Both can use a frozen model and imply no gradient training. Check whether feedback enters later context, applies to the new state, and actually improves a verified result; iteration count does not establish learning.

    **Illustrative example:** Correcting a wrong number is a current revision. Saving 'check source tables before quoting numbers' for future tasks is cross-trial state.

    Sources: [Self-Refine](../../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md) · [Reflexion](../../../../agent-research/2303.11366-reflexion/README-en.md)

### Why aren't retaining low-scoring Agent S4 descendants and rejecting non-improving RSIFlow candidates contradictory? {#cross-population-versus-current-parent}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** They maintain different search states. The Agent S4 population retains exploration sources, and low-scoring descendants may help later search; private validation chooses parents. RSIFlow tests each candidate from a frozen parent and failure leaves the next starting state unchanged. One preserves diversity and the other governs the current version. Archive admission is not release, and neither needs the same monotonicity criterion.

    **Illustrative example:** An interface variant with a new action can remain in S4 despite a low score. After a non-improving workflow patch, RSIFlow starts again from the original workflow.

    Sources: [Evolving Agent Interfaces](../../../../agent-research/2610.28601-agent-s4/README-en.md) · [RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent](../../../../agent-research/2610.21791-rsiflow/README-en.md)

### Why doesn't a paired local behavior gain in HarnessLens replace AgentX production-release judgment? {#cross-local-admission-versus-production}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Local validation asks whether the selected behavior gains positively and attributably. Deployment also involves business distributions, guardrails, and actual resources. AgentX can veto a primary gain and records positive and negative experiments. The stages can connect, but small local protocol success supplies neither traffic causality nor authorization to release.

    **Illustrative example:** Offline recovery may improve while request latency rises in production. Functional evidence can hold and guardrails can still reject release.

    Sources: [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](../../../../agent-research/2608.27311-harnesslens/README-en.md) · [AgentX: Towards Agent-Driven Self-Iteration of Industrial Recommender Systems](../../../../agent-research/2606.26859-agentx/README-en.md)

### Why doesn't RuHarness resample novelty and redundancy with each Dirichlet draw? {#cross-oct29-method-boundary}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** They describe overlap of fixed trajectory sets, not six-cell outcome probabilities. Randomizing them changes the uncertainty model. A conservative posterior quantile also does not show that actual agents improved.

    **Illustrative example:** Two criteria flag the same failure set. Sampling a success/failure probability should not change that overlap.

    Sources: [Self-Refine](../../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md) · [When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement](../../../../agent-research/2610.36826-ruharness/README-en.md)

### Why can't one correction-success metric summarize CROP and Self-Refine even though both revise text from feedback? {#cross-crop-prompt-versus-current-answer}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Self-Refine mainly revises the current answer. CROP changes system prompts offline and selects evaluated candidates using accuracy and CoT-normalized output-token cost. A better current answer does not demonstrate prompt transfer; shorter prompts do not ensure shorter or correct answers. Real LLM callbacks and independent validation are additional evidence.

    **Illustrative example:** Correcting one arithmetic answer and finding a concise prompt for unseen arithmetic are different tests. The last newly written prompt cannot be called best before evaluation.

    Sources: [CROP: Token-Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Regularized Prompt Optimization](../../../../agent-research/2604.14214-crop/README-en.md) · [Self-Refine](../../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md)

### Why are neither high EvalAlloc predicted fitness nor high RuHarness criterion utility actual agent success rates? {#cross-evalalloc-fitness-versus-rubric-frontier}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** EvalAlloc estimates unobserved SEARCH outcomes against fixed references, retaining observed cells and requiring confirmation. RuHarness estimates conservative diagnostic value of criteria, and candidate harnesses still need independent validation. These govern budgets and criteria, not outcomes of unexecuted tasks.

    **Illustrative example:** If only 20 of 300 items are evaluated, completed mean 0.8 does not mean 240 actual completions. A criterion that covers failures does not solve tasks.

    Sources: [Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?](../../../../agent-research/2610.37276-evalalloc/README-en.md) · [When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement](../../../../agent-research/2610.36826-ruharness/README-en.md)

### How does Strategist retaining failed strategies differ from Reflexion storing lessons and EvalAlloc confirming champions? {#cross-blueprint-archive-versus-current-pick}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Library admission preserves executable structures and measurement cards without adopting them for the current answer. Final selection still requires both splits to win. Reflexion mainly stores readable experience, whereas EvalAlloc controls observations and confirmation rather than generating structure. Structural archives, lessons, and adopted strategies need separate records.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: an expensive voting strategy may remain a component for a future decomposition program, without replacing the current cheaper reference merely because it entered the library.

    Sources: [Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.03618-strategist/README-en.md) · [Reflexion](../../../../agent-research/2303.11366-reflexion/README-en.md) · [Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?](../../../../agent-research/2610.37276-evalalloc/README-en.md)

### Can a shared file index and a tool reminder added after one run fails use the same training-gain table? {#cross-environment-index-versus-in-run-edit}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Not directly. EnvOpt's index changes a shared environment representation and needs validation on tasks not used to propose the edit. Meta²'s reminder is a bounded harness edit for the current run. What transfers is guidance for making edits, not that reminder.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: search tasks can reuse a directory index, but a recovery reminder for one missing permission should not persist in unrelated tasks.

    Sources: [EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments](../../../../agent-research/2611.07372-envopt/README-en.md) · [Meta²: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.05139-meta-square/README-en.md) · [From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?](../../../../agent-research/2611.05108-continual-autoresearch/README-en.md)

### Can a patch that raises average validation score but breaks old cases pass PASE, FGSE and Verified Quantum Wiki alike? {#cross-risk-gates-versus-validation}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Those two observations do not decide all three. PASE's explicit rule requires strict held-out improvement. FGSE separately checks archived damage and falsification risk and may reject. Verified Quantum Wiki needs specification-bound independent proof and resource improvement, not an average score. Match admission to observable evidence and update scope.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: nine improved tasks can hide one duplicate payment. An average-score gate may pass while a risk gate rejects; the quantum wiki does not use that task-score criterion at all.

    Sources: [Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution](../../../../agent-research/2611.14019-pase/README-en.md) · [When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.14326-fgse/README-en.md) · [Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI](../../../../agent-research/2611.09822-verified-quantum-wiki/README-en.md)

### Can SME approval of a correction rule substitute for a program patch's validation improvement, or vice versa? {#cross-cross-rule-governance-versus-program-validation}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. The former authorizes a downstream exception within target/collateral scope; the latter measures a paired program on isolated validation. Their locations and evidence differ, and neither is semantically established by syntax or type checks.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: an emergency-procurement exception may be authorized by a human. A spreadsheet-formula patch needs strictly improved validation. Calling approval a benchmark gain, or using a score gain to authorize policy, confuses evidence.

    Sources: [Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback](../../../../agent-research/2608.15591-agent-gym/README-en.md) · [Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution](../../../../agent-research/2611.14019-pase/README-en.md)

### After strict-improvement comparison and two review rounds, may ScientistTwo skip a ScientistOne-style evidence audit? {#cross-cross-scientist-control-versus-evidence-integrity}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Comparison and review judgments come from external models or people; the control kernel only schedules calls, updates and stopping. Independent score recomputation, split isolation, log provenance and method/code consistency still need checking. A high score does not prove provenance.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: an external comparator returns true based on a copied high score, and the kernel faithfully updates best. Only execution and provenance audits reveal that the score does not belong to the current code.

    Sources: [ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI](../../../../agent-research/2609.19644-scientist-two/README-en.md) · [ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence](../../../../agent-research/2605.26340-scientist-one/README-en.md)

### If both an agent harness and an environment Contract change and success rises, may the gain be attributed to EnvHarness? {#cross-cross-environment-and-agent-harness-attribution}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Fix the policy, task splits and agent execution layer, compare learning/skills from original versus wrapped environments, then evaluate on untouched environments. Fixed toy wrapper tests cover neither learning nor transfer and do not integrate the two systems.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: adding a test tool while blocking direct submission may reduce failures because of either change. Separate controls are needed for attribution.

    Sources: [EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning](../../../../agent-research/2608.19880-envharness/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Would MLE-STAR's ablation targeting and MARS's budget reward always choose the same expensive but influential change? {#cross-cross-block-targeting-versus-budget-allocation}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Ablation asks where refinement matters; a budget reward also trades performance against execution time. Neither automatically implements the other's search rule. A combination must separately fix validation and measured cost.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: a preprocessing change gains 0.01 in one hour, while another branch gains 0.008 in one minute. Influence and budget-limited exploration value can differ.

    Sources: [MLE-STAR: Machine Learning Engineering Agent via Search and Targeted Refinement](../../../../agent-research/2506.15692-mle-star/README-en.md) · [MARS: Modular Agent with Reflective Search for Automated AI Research](../../../../agent-research/2602.02660-mars-research/README-en.md)

### Why does verifying a published matrix construction establish neither local AlphaEvolve discovery nor complete research integrity? {#cross-cross-discovery-score-versus-claim-grounding}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** It does not execute proposals, archives, or distributed search, and it does not audit all numbers, citations, or prose/code alignment. Evidence supports only the object and property actually checked.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: a valid complex rank-48 construction does not establish rank48 over every field or local rediscovery. Each stronger claim needs separate evidence.

    Sources: [AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery](../../../../agent-research/2506.13131-alphaevolve/README-en.md) · [ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence](../../../../agent-research/2605.26340-scientist-one/README-en.md)

### Why are Co-Director's high UCB score and RuHarness's lower posterior quantile not interchangeable promotion evidence? {#cross-cross-colm-co-director}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** UCB intentionally rewards underexplored directions optimistically to select another attempt. RuHarness discounts uncertain rubric estimates through joint posterior utility quantiles and separately requires strict independent validation improvement. Their scheduling objects and risk preferences differ; factored judge ratings also do not establish causal contributions.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: a creative arm tried once can receive another attempt because its exploration bonus is high, but a rubric associated with one failed task should not be promoted on that basis. The harness candidate still has to pass validation. This is not a measured result.

    Sources: [Co-Director: Agentic Generative Video Storytelling](../../../../agent-research/2604.24842-co-director/README-en.md) · [When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement](../../../../agent-research/2610.36826-ruharness/README-en.md)

### Does increased MULTILOOP accuracy show subagent delegation is repaired? {#cross-cross-nov15-multiloop}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Prompt-only/tool changes can explain much of the gain while orchestration faults remain. Attributing gains to delegation requires relevant controlled evidence.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: adding PDF retrieval can improve scores without fixing duplicate task assignment.

    Sources: [MULTILOOP: Evolving Multi-Agent Harnesses for Complex Information-Seeking Tasks](../../../../agent-research/2611.15754-multiloop/README-en.md) · [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](../../../../agent-research/2608.27311-harnesslens/README-en.md)

### Can reference-proof candidate selection count as a stronger ScientistTwo-style review? {#cross-cross-nov15-stellar-colosseum}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. References belong only to the final benchmark grader. Providing them to selection misrepresents an oracle best-of-two ceiling as reasoning ability; research review also needs held-out boundaries.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: reading the standard solution before picking a paper is not leakage-free autonomous research.

    Sources: [Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science](../../../../agent-research/2609.15983-stellar-colosseum/README-en.md) · [ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI](../../../../agent-research/2609.19644-scientist-two/README-en.md)

### Does a better Harness² candidate answer establish that AskALCF needs new knowledge? {#cross-cross-nov18-askalcf-protocol}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Better text does not prove missing authoritative corpus evidence. Use answer-blind R/C: false/true means retrieval, both false means knowledge. Then validate against frozen references and null controls.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: duplicating a page already in the corpus may conceal a top-k retrieval defect.

    Sources: [AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support](../../../../agent-research/2611.15700-askalcf-protocol/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Does a high repaired audit score authorize automatic deployment in Harness² or ProdPilot? {#cross-cross-nov18-prodpilot-protocol}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. ProdPilot also needs no failing P0, the probability condition, a determined build and explicit approval; Harness² supplies no equivalent production gate. A deploy call that raises leaves status unknown and should not be blindly retried.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: score 93 with one failing P0 remains closed; inspect external state after service-creation timeout.

    Sources: [ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects](../../../../agent-research/2611.17381-prodpilot-protocol/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### How does this differ from Harness² execution comparison? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-detourbench}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** DetourBench measures a fixed trajectory against a provable offline minimum. Harness² changes a harness through execution contrasts without gold or rubrics. Their objects and information privileges differ.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: choosing an anonymous artifact does not prove its access count was minimal.

    Sources: [DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds](../../../../agent-research/2611.20844-detourbench/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Is its reference information the same as an AskALCF sufficiency probe? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-sciresearch-eval}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. This evaluator has exact physical truth. AskALCF sufficiency sees only question and documents, not generation. Each reference and permission boundary must remain separate.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: a scorer may use conductivity truth; the experiment-design actor may not.

    Sources: [SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.21541-sciresearch-eval/README-en.md) · [AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support](../../../../agent-research/2611.15700-askalcf-protocol/README-en.md)

### Why is this not Harness²-style self-improvement? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-silentguard}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** SilentGuard applies fixed release/withhold rules. It does not propose or integrate harness edits; Harness² requires execution contrasts and accumulated experience. They can compose but are not substitutes.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: retrying an API once is not proposing a new tool policy.

    Sources: [Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures](../../../../agent-research/2611.20595-silentguard/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Can a GEAR union be adopted without evaluation unlike Harness² composition? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-metaact}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Conjunction can block more actions and harm successful traces, so replay is repeated. Harness² likewise executes compositions, but uses a different evidence type.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: recompute eff and ok even when both separate guards passed.

    Sources: [MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.20655-metaact/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### How does ELITE differ from rubric-free Harness²? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-elite-eval-free}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Harness² runs tasks and compares behavior; ELITE integrates implementation-level evidence while excluding downstream task outcomes. Rubric-free does not imply identical information boundaries.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: handing ELITE an offspring success-rate table changes the algorithm.

    Sources: [Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents](../../../../agent-research/2611.21056-elite-eval-free/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Can it replace the Harness² selector? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-resolution-hypothesis}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. It estimates measurement variability, not mechanism compatibility or task fitness. Candidate quality, selection and evaluation resolution are distinct objects.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: a low-variance wrong answer remains wrong.

    Sources: [The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements](../../../../agent-research/2611.23068-resolution-hypothesis/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Why is it not the same experiment as Harness²? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-skillbuffbench}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** It holds configuration fixed while varying access and memory; Harness² actively edits a harness and accumulates experience. Evolution artifacts and evaluation factors are distinct.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: installing new skills changes a supposedly fixed benchmark cell.

    Sources: [SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory](../../../../agent-research/2611.22017-skillbuffbench/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Can it reuse AskALCF probe labels directly? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-gandalf-bvb}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Deliverable criteria differ from answer-blind document sufficiency. Questions, references and permissions are different.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: an available citation does not prove the slide contains the correct chart.

    Sources: [Verifying Agents in Rubric-Graded Environments](../../../../agent-research/2611.22841-gandalf-bvb/README-en.md) · [AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support](../../../../agent-research/2611.15700-askalcf-protocol/README-en.md)

### Is this the same as ELITE evaluation-free evolution? {#cross-cross-nov18-latest-self-organized-learning}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. ELITE prescribes same-parent exploration and code integration without downstream results. Here teachers organize learning from self-generated-game feedback. Interventions and feedback permissions differ.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: forcing seven-child integration changes the free self-organization setting.

    Sources: [Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?](../../../../agent-research/2611.23219-self-organized-learning/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Why is it not the same as rubric-free Harness²? {#cross-cross-nov19-ahe-beta}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Harness² composes candidates using current-task execution contrasts and retains improvement experience. AHE-Beta selects structural changes through session requirements, role separation and review admission.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: comparing two artifacts is not the same evidence as verifying interruption delivery.

    Sources: [Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses](../../../../agent-research/2611.24924-ahe-beta/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Does its safety gate prove no risk increase, unlike Harness²? {#cross-cross-nov19-safe-personal-rsi}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. It compares maximum primary-category point estimates; nonmaximal or total primary risk can rise. Harness² execution contrasts are a different, non-domain-risk criterion.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: keeping the maximum at2/20 while another category rises from0 to1/20 may still pass.

    Sources: [Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates](../../../../agent-research/2611.23651-safe-personal-rsi/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### How does the goal differ from Harness² or kernel benchmarks? {#cross-cross-nov19-rsibench-infra}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** It checks whether the entire serving/training pipeline becomes faster while preserving quality. Harness task success or kernel speedup cannot establish end-to-end throughput.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: doubling kernel speed has little impact when transfer dominates90% of runtime.

    Sources: [RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?](../../../../agent-research/2611.24395-rsibench-infra/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

### Are SearchInject and SilentGuard the same gate? {#cross-cross-nov19-searchinject}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. One screens retrieved context and the other validates tool-result invariants. Passing one does not certify the other.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: low-risk text may still report an API value violating the requested filter.

    Sources: [SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search](../../../../agent-research/2611.02643-searchinject/README-en.md) · [Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures](../../../../agent-research/2611.20595-silentguard/README-en.md)

## Update log {#updates}

Updates record new approaches, changed trade-offs, and follow-up evidence.

**2026-11-19** · Explicit numerical fixtures check feature order, strict thresholding, empirical clean cost and refill. There are no real payloads, SciFact retrieval, fitted classifiers, generators or security certification. A lower threshold can remove more candidates yet refill a surviving attack page from below rank10. Full high-cost experiments are not reproduced; review DONE.

Affected: [SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search](../../../../agent-research/2611.02643-searchinject/README-en.md) · [Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures](../../../../agent-research/2611.20595-silentguard/README-en.md)

**2026-11-19** · Only primary review, cost assessment, bilingual documentation and learning material are delivered. An OCI schema stub, arbitrary microbenchmark or small single-GPU model is not labeled an RSIBench-Infra integration. local_operator=null and no executable evolve operator is advertised. The project page https://rsibench-infra.github.io is verified, but no paper-specific public source repository was verified. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

Affected: [RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?](../../../../agent-research/2611.24395-rsibench-infra/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

**2026-11-19** · The local slice implements evaluator Replay records, maximum-category-risk admission, persistent veto, minimum/completion checks, both strict-majority confirmation protocols, and rollback gain retention including its zero-gain convention. It does not implement Willow/Kicker, email tools, attack search, LLM repair, a semantic judge, verification rollouts or OAuth fixes. Replay records belong only to the offline evaluator, not the actor. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

Affected: [Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates](../../../../agent-research/2611.23651-safe-personal-rsi/README-en.md) · [Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](../../../../agent-research/2610.14224-harness2/README-en.md)

**2026-11-19** · The local slice implements typed Evidence/Requirement delivery, covers resolution for verified consolidations, and a pure merge_eligible decision bound to head and RFC.
